selectionPolicy: 24-family DEV pilot: 8 food-treat (prior) + 4 each from toy, animal-care, garden-pest, neighbors at the indices above, chosen for functional/evidential contrast (explicit-species cases, title-only thin case, dual-purpose dispute, equipment and off-taxonomy hard negatives). Not lexical-first, not random/proportional. One withholding variant of food-treat index 675 retains its familyId with no independent support. V2 adds 2 locked-bank DEV families with direct-quote dual-species evidence (562 NaturVet supplements powder, 907 Four Paws grooming eye wipes); no resampling or label drift from prior outcomes.

independentAgentExecution.reason: Subagent depth limit reached; no independent second-agent review. Single-agent manual adjudication in this session; 120-family goal incomplete.

provenanceJoinPolicy: Each record joins by sku to development-gold.json. sourceIndex identifies the immutable primary source row and supplies originalSku, familyId, canonicalUrl, sourceLocator, retrievedAt, productIdentity, and evidenceLimitations. sourceHash on each record is inherited by every local citation. A local citation's locator is an exact pointer to the supplied capture excerpt object; that object also retains the external capture URL/DOM locator. Each per-target citation ID resolves to that sourceHash + locator + literal exact quote; this normalization avoids duplicating the same evidence for every target. Page citations have their separate verified-import sourceHash below. Type and attribute citations resolve against the frozen approved bundle and its exact names/descriptions/options/profile members, never current catalog fields.
adjudicationScope: Controlled targets only; free-text claims, composition, materials, size/color, brand, compiled projections and merchandising PF24/PF25 strings are not authored as gold. For known types every controlled profile member is assessed. Explicit dog-only breed-size semantics make that target inapplicable to cat/fish-only products even where the broad shared profile contains it. Non-profile controlled targets are separately outside scope, not no-fit. For unresolved types, direct supported facts may still be labeled, while profile applicability remains unresolved and must not be treated as production-qualified target scope.

reviewRules.missing-discriminator: The cited retained product facts do not establish a permitted answer for this target. Missing evidence is not a negative claim and does not prove no-fit.
reviewRules.single-value-dispute: The positive source gives multiple distinct values or conflicting statements, but the actual profile is single-valued and provides no priority rule. Do not choose the first value or call a combination Assorted.
reviewRules.outside-profile: The controlled attribute is absent from the actual effective type profile; record inapplicability separately from insufficient evidence or no-fit.
reviewRules.dog-only-breed: Approved breed-size description is Dog breed size category.; an explicitly cat/fish-only product is inapplicable, not an unsupported dog size guess.
reviewRules.partial-pages: These are positively supported verified category identities, not an exhaustive set. The catalog has null parent links and no complete membership definitions, including seasonal/featured inclusion criteria. Specific categories are preferred; Shop All is retained only where no supported specific form/texture child can be chosen. No complete empty set is claimed.
reviewRules.unknown-pages: Available evidence or catalog inclusion semantics do not establish a positively supported page subset. Empty unknown is never known-empty.
reviewRules.unresolved-applicability: Product type is unresolved. Field facts are individually evidenced but are not a resolution of the actual profile pointer. Missing profile-specific targets must not be inferred as inapplicable. Review remains necessary.

typeCitationPolicy: taxonomyTypes ids in records resolve to bundle.productTypes[id].name as the exact quoted approved type definition available here; all 74 descriptions are null. Applicable profiles resolve through the actual attributeProfileId, not a guessed universal field set. No fuller definition has been invented.

food-form.quote: Physical form of food or feed.

fuel-type.quote: Fuel or power source for heaters, splitters, and power equipment.

evidencePolicy: Manual product-fact adjudication against the frozen approved type names, definitions, profiles, guidance, cardinality, aliases, and evidence policies. Official structured catalog excerpts retain their feed locators and are not represented as individual product-page fetches. No brand/photo/absence inference for composition, material, species, or claims.
pagePolicy: Verified ID/name pairs only. Generic brand directories, navigation, services, editorial, and example pages are excluded. Positive supported specific pages may be partial; an empty partial/unknown set is not known-empty. Complete requires review of the entire eligible catalog scope, including applicable genuine brand pages and the max-four/specific-over-Shop-All rules.
cardinalityLimitation: Frozen single cardinality everywhere EXCEPT species in profile-grooming and profile-supplements (approved bay-state-v7 multiple). Explicit Dog+Cat is known [Dog, Cat]; singletons declared as one-element arrays.
